note: Counts and structured fields only, from tests/manual/decision-point-check.py over the runs in runs.txt (paths relative to the run-data root). Message and entry text were used only for keyword booleans and id parsing. No transcript, candidate, flag or challenge text.

critic.workbook_access: none by design (recon.read limited to recon/domain-solver/engineer; Critic gets Coordinator excerpts)

answers.Q1_solver_not_seen: not supported: 127/127 active open or supported entries presented at 30 full-view round starts; dispatch-cited ids presented 20/20; 0 omission events
answers.Q1_coordinator: no omissions or failures; facts/refuted truncated to one line by design; 24 of 28 active hypotheses at end carry evidence refs the Coordinator view does not show
answers.supported_upgrades_without_new_evidence: not supported as a pattern: 2 upgrades to supported in 13 runs, both with new refs; hypotheses are rarely updated at all (5 updates; 28 active at end)
answers.handback_vs_entries: unknown: keyword proxy saturates (hedge words in 34/41 handbacks, 2/15 hypothesis-writing rounds); needs semantic comparison
answers.Q4_resume_vs_new: directional only: previous round's own open hypotheses/questions superseded next round 10/16 (resume) vs 6/15 (new); pairs leaving all untouched 2/9 vs 6/11; new unlinked hypotheses/questions 2 vs 8. Resume concentrated in 4 runs (7 pairs in one run) and chosen by the Coordinator, so confounded
answers.skill_across_sessions: 1 sample (rtd2-ezoj-on-2); Skill loads across the 13 runs: 3 (recon 1, recovery-critic 1, domain-solver 1)

gaps: workbook rows are scoped by run_id, so entries cannot be pre-seeded for a new run (experience-store recon_turns queries)
launcher always starts the Coordinator as primary; no single-role entry
reusable: workbookView/coordinatorView in apps/launcher/src/workbook.ts build role views from rows without a model
packages/opencode-bridge startManagedOpenCode, used by tests/manual/recon-context-interface.ts with a local mock provider

coordinator_view_size_with_hypothesis_re.method: coordinatorView recomputed after every slotted decision of each run (identity cleaning, remaining_min fixed), with hypothesis evidence_refs kept vs emptied; cap 8000 chars

resume_rounds_check.scope: same 13 runs; every Solver round after the first (29 rounds)
resume_rounds_check.method: round boundaries from task.source/task.completion (dispatch times for r1 and wbp-ezoj-on-2); writes by the round's session within the round; superseded_own = at least one write supersedes an earlier domain-solver entry; dispatch_asks_update = dispatch text contains 取代/supersede/更新/合併/關閉 (keyword proxy)
resume_rounds_check.answer: real runs do not reproduce the synthetic pattern (resume rounds with no writes: 0/13) nor a resume advantage once rtd2-ezoj-on-1 is set aside (other resume rounds 0/6 superseded); in both modes most later rounds add new entries without superseding their own (16/29), and superseding is concentrated in two runs

hint_estimate.scope: same 13 runs, Solver writes and rounds

write_time_option.rule: slotted Solver write without supersedes while the Solver has an active entry in the same slot
write_time_option.note: fires mostly on facts that accumulate by design

round_option.rule: open hypotheses/questions written by the Solver before the round start and not superseded in it (ids only)

near_duplicates.method: character-bigram Jaccard of each non-superseding write against the writer's own same-slot active entries
